newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-STROBL WINS WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-STROBL WINS WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM.

text.p: Austrian Josef Strobl took the first-run lead, then held on to win the World Cup giant slalom Monday.
Strobl, who won a downhill two years ago in Val d'Isere but whose previous best giant slalom finish was 10th place, had an unofficial two-run time of two minutes, 31.42 seconds.

Teammate Hans Knaus was second in 2:31.84 as Austria finished 1-2 in a men's World Cup race for the second time in 24 hours at Park City Ski Area. Michael Von Gruenigen of Switzerland, the reigning World Cup champion, was third in 2:31.90.
